sn37.3:1.1: Pañcimāni bhikkhave mātugāmassa āveṇikāni dukkhāni yāni mātugāmo paccanubhoti aññatreva purisehi ||
sn37.3:1.3: Idha bhikkhave mātugāmo daharo va samāno patikulaṃ gacchati ñātakehi vinā hoti ||
sn37.3:1.4: idam bhikkhave mātugāmassa pathamam āveṇikam dukkhaṃ || yam mātugāmo paccanubhoti aññatreva purisehi || || 4
sn37.3:1.5: Puna ca param bhikkhave mātugāmo utunī hoti ||
sn37.3:1.6: idam bhikkhave mātugāmassa dutiyam āveṇikam dukkhaṃ yaṃ mātugāmo paccanubhoti aññatreva purisehi || || 5
sn37.3:1.7: Puna ca param bhikkhave mātugāmo gabbhinī hoti ||
sn37.3:1.8: idam bhikkhave mātugamassa tatiyam āveṇikam dukkhaṃ yam mātugamo paccānubhoti aññatreva purisehi || || 6
sn37.3:1.9: Puna ca param bhikkhave mātugāmo vijāyāti ||
sn37.3:1.10: idam bhikkhave mātugāmassa catuttham āveṇikaṃ dukkhaṃ yam mātugāmo paccanubhoti aññatreva purisehi || || 7
sn37.3:1.11: Puna ca param bhikkhave mātugāmo purisassa pāricariyam upeti ||
sn37.3:1.12: idaṃ kho bhikkhave mātugāmassa pañcamam āveṇikam dukkhaṃ yam mātugāmo paccanubhoti aññatreva purisehīti || || 8
sn37.3:1.13: Imāni kho bhikkhave pañca mātugāmassa āveṇikāni dukkhāni yāni mātugāmo paccanubhoti aññatreva purisehīti || || 2
